guidelines: Leave no trace: leave the campsite as you found it, stay on the trail.
Report hazards only for what you have seen; you must be on site to confirm someone else's report.
Give sources and dates for route submissions; do not copy copyrighted topos.
Harassment, discrimination and dangerous challenge content are permanently banned.

safety.title: Safety: SOS, country directory and first aid
safety.metaDescription: Press-and-hold SOS, satellite SOS state machine, emergency numbers and mountain rescue directory for 58 countries, 12 offline first-aid guides and return plans.
safety.lead: Zirtan's safety layer: from the hazard map to satellite SOS, from the country directory to offline first-aid guides.

sos.title: Press and hold
sos.text: Hold the SOS button for 3 seconds: 112 (or the local number) is dialled, your location goes to emergency contacts and live location switches to SOS mode.

sos.title: Over satellite
sos.text: With no network, a 160-character compressed SOS is queued through a paired device (inReach, ZOLEO, SPOT, iPhone satellite, Starlink Mini).

sos.title: State machine
sos.text: Ready → sent → received → team en route → resolved. Every stage notifies your emergency contacts; the nearest rescue centre is shown.

safety.layersLead: Cellular → Wi-Fi → satellite → none. The app picks the best layer; coverage estimates work offline with the map pack.
safety.countriesLead: Emergency numbers and rescue organisations; the full directory and consular notes are in the app.
safety.firstAidLead: 12 guides open without internet; Zirtan AI reads the steps aloud.
safety.returnLead: Start, expected return time and grace period; if you do not return, your emergency contacts receive your route and last location.
safety.hazardsLead: Rockfall, avalanche, flood, wildlife, severe weather, damaged trail, closed area. Severity, radius, validity period; 'I saw it too' confirmations and a 'resolved' mark for the reporter.
safety.disclaimer: This page is not medical advice. In an emergency call the local emergency number first.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: Zirtan privacy policy draft: what we collect, why, how long we keep it and your rights.

sections.p: This policy applies to the Zirtan mobile app and the zirtan.app website. The app currently runs on a demo data provider; personal data is stored on your device (AsyncStorage) and is not sent to a server. This policy will be updated when the real backend goes live.

Account details (email, display name), profile content (adventure posts, photos, routes), location data (only with your permission; live location sharing is time-limited and cancellable), emergency contact details (only for SOS), device and usage data (crash reports, performance).

Providing the service (routes, maps, matching), safety (hazard alerts, SOS, return plans), community verification, payment processing (via RevenueCat / iyzico; we never store card details) and legal obligations.

Your location is shared only with people you choose (followers, matches) or, in SOS mode, with emergency contacts and rescue teams. We do not sell your data to third parties for advertising. Infrastructure providers (hosting, payments, map tiles) process only the data needed for the service.
Personal data is deleted within 30 days of account deletion, except payment records subject to legal retention. Live location history is deleted after 24 hours.
For access, rectification, erasure, portability and objection write to privacy@zirtan.app. GDPR applies in the European Union and KVKK in Türkiye.
This website uses no analytics cookies; your theme preference is kept in your browser's local storage. Map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap servers (your IP address is sent to OSM).
Zirtan is not designed for users under 16.

kvkk.title: KVKK disclosure notice
kvkk.metaDescription: Draft disclosure notice under Türkiye's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

sections.p: Zirtan Teknoloji (in formation), Istanbul. Email: kvkk@zirtan.app. This notice is prepared under Article 10 of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.

Identity (name, username), contact (email), location (with your permission), visual and audio records (photos and videos you share), transaction security (IP, device ID, session), first-aid usage records that may qualify as health data (on your device only), emergency contact details (only for SOS).

Performance of the contract (service delivery), legitimate interest (safety, fraud prevention), explicit consent (location sharing, live streaming, marketing emails) and legal obligation (payment records, requests from authorities).

To hosting, payment (iyzico, RevenueCat), map tile (OpenStreetMap) and live streaming providers; in SOS mode to your emergency contacts and rescue teams; to authorities where legally required. International transfers follow Board decisions and your explicit consent.
Through the mobile app, website forms and support correspondence; by automatic or partly automatic means.

To learn whether your data is processed, request information, learn whether it is used for its purpose, know the third parties it is transferred to, request rectification, erasure/destruction, object and claim compensation for damages. Applications go to kvkk@zirtan.app or in writing under the Communiqué on Application Procedures to the Data Controller; they are answered within 30 days.
